system.description:
You animate the corpse of a creature to do your bidding.

Choose a corpse within 10 spaces of Size 1 or smaller. It reanimates under your control.

The reanimated creature has half its maximum Stamina. It maintains all the physical statistics it had while it was alive but retains no magical or supernatural abilities. It automatically succeeds on Willpower checks and is immune to mind-affecting conditions.

This spell lasts for 1 minute, after which the corpse falls apart and can no longer be used.

You may only have 1 creature reanimated at a time.

Each extra success extends the duration by +1 minutes.

Alternatively, you may increase the Size of the creature you can reanimate by +1 per 4 extra successes.
